description: Paid. Use when asked whether a cryptocurrency is undervalued, overvalued or fairly priced: the True Value Rankings fair value verdict for one coin (ticker or name), with the exact Fair Value Gap and TVR Estimated Value, the main reasons (which of the 8 metrics lift or hold back the TVR Score, and the written scoring factors), how far the gap is from the nearest category line, and plain caveats. No market price or market cap. $0.02 per call, paid in-band with x402 (USDC on Base) or MPP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the offer (isError with the x402 PaymentRequired in structuredContent) and charges nothing. An unknown coin is refused before any payment. Free alternative: get_tvr_score (TVR Score, rank, valuation category and all 8 metric scores). Data from True Value Rankings (truevaluerankings.com).

coin.description: Ticker or name of a coin covered by TVR (BTC, Bitcoin, ETH, LTC, XMR, SOL, ADA, AVAX, DOT, POL, LINK)

boundary.description: The nearest category line and how far the gap is from it
